title: Cybersecurity Manager Licence
description: Licence attesting the professional competence of a natural person as a cybersecurity manager. A conformity assessment body accredited under ISO/IEC 17024 issues it under the certification scheme of the Slovak National Security Authority (NBÚ) and the knowledge standard of NBÚ Decree No. 492/2022 Coll., Annex 5. The role corresponds to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) role profile of ENISA's European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF) v1. Domain: cybersecurity professional qualifications. Its status is the licence's record on the licence registry contract named in credentialStatus. VCDM 1.1; extends the EBSI Verifiable Attestation.

holderName.title: Full name with titles
holderName.description: As on the licence, e.g. John Doe, PhD

licenceNumber.title: Licence number
licenceNumber.description: Unique in the certification body's register, e.g. 248

role.title: Role
role.description: The role under Act No. 69/2018 Coll. and NBÚ Decree No. 492/2022 Coll. (manažér kybernetickej bezpečnosti)

ecsfRoleProfile.title: ECSF role profile
ecsfRoleProfile.description: The corresponding role profile of ENISA's European Cybersecurity Skills Framework v1 (@ciso)

knowledgeStandard.title: Knowledge standard
knowledgeStandard.default: Decree of the National Security Authority No. 492/2022 Coll., Annex 5

certificationScheme.title: Certification scheme
certificationScheme.description: The scheme and its version under which the licence was granted
certificationScheme.default: NBÚ certification scheme for verifying the professional competence of a cybersecurity manager, version 1.2

certificationBody.title: Certification body
certificationBody.description: The conformity assessment body, accredited under ISO/IEC 17024, that granted the licence, e.g. Example Certification Body Ltd.

issueDate.title: Date of issue
issueDate.description: Day of the decision to grant the licence; its validity starts that day

signatory.title: Signed by (name and position)
signatory.description: e.g. Jane Doe, Head of the Certification Body

previousLicenceNumber.title: Previous licence number
previousLicenceNumber.description: When the licence extends an earlier one (recertification): that licence's number

trainingName.title: Training name
trainingName.description: Training completed before the examination, if any, e.g. Cybersecurity Manager

funding.title: Funding
funding.description: e.g. Recovery and Resilience Plan of the Slovak Republic, Component 17, Reform No. 5
